Dr. Albert Vollmer is a 1952 graduate of Hamilton College. He enjoyed a successful career in the field of orthodontics while pursuing his passion for jazz.
In 1973 he organized the Harlem Blues and Jazz Band, a group of veteran musicians who have now performed across the U.S. and around the world.
Al was interviewed in New Hartford, NY on June 8, 2017, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to be talking to Dr. Albert Vollmer after a long time waiting to do so. Hamilton class of ’52, right?
That’s — so you’re back for your 65th —
And we had had a brief — I had overheard you talking a little bit about the music that you heard at Hamilton, and that you heard someone playing a Fats Waller record —
